newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian SIR20 rubber offer prices were unchanged in late trading on Wednesday as market sentiment continued to be poor, traders said.
Traders said offer prices were unchanged at 47.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 46.00 fob Padang, 46.75 fob Surabaya and 46.0 fob Jambi and 46.25 fob Pontianak.
"We are lost today because there are no factors which could boost this weak sentiment. We are looking for buyers but they seem to have disappeared," said one trader.
Traders said they expected the market to stay weak for the rest of the week. The market is closed on Thursday for a public holiday. It will reopen on Friday.
